subject: Acme Health — request for latest penetration test report and secure transfer options
messages:
From: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest penetration test findings + secure transfer options

Hi Aisha,

Can you share the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's hosted API? Our security team needs the full report (vendor redactions allowed) and confirmation of the assessment scope (was the hosted API included end-to-end, including data plane endpoints?). We also need to know how you prefer to transfer sensitive artifacts — we require an encrypted channel and an auditable delivery.

High-level asks from our end:
- Latest full pen-test report (or redacted copy if there are third-party NDAs)
- Executive summary for our SOC2 evidence binder
- Transfer mechanism (presigned link with IP restriction vs encrypted package via a secure portal)
- Certificate/attestation of the testing vendor and date of test

Please Cc our procurement contact, Nina Park (nina.park@acmehealth.com), for logistics and any paperwork. If you have a standard procedure for handing over these reports to enterprise customers, send that over.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Lewis
Senior InfoSec Engineer
Acme Health

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test findings + secure transfer options

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can share the materials and confirm the scope. Short answers up front: yes, the hosted API (control plane + public data-plane endpoints) was in scope for our most recent external assessment (Nov 2026). The assessment was performed by Red Harbor Security (independent third party); we can include vendor attestation in the package.

Transfer options we offer (pick one):
1) Presigned S3 link with 7-day expiration + restrict to Acme Health IP ranges. We can also add a one-time token for access logs.
2) Encrypted ZIP container (AES-256) uploaded to our secure transfer portal; we will share the password out-of-band (phone or a separate encrypted message).

What we typically deliver for enterprise reviews:
- redwood_pt_exec_summary_2026.pdf (redacted executive summary)
- redwood_pt_full_report_encrypted_2026.zip (full report, encrypted)
- vendor_attestation_redharbor_2026.pdf

Before we share the full package, a couple quick clarifications so we produce the right artifact:
- Do you want customer-identifying data redacted from the full report, or will Acme review redactions after delivery?
- Which transfer method do you prefer (S3 presigned link + IP restriction OR encrypted ZIP + out-of-band password)?
- Do you need a DocuSign statement of confidentiality or an existing MSA reference in our cover note?

If you confirm, I can have the package ready in 48 hours and either send a presigned link or upload the encrypted ZIP and confirm the password by phone.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0132

From: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test findings + secure transfer options

Aisha —

Thanks. We'll take option 2 (encrypted ZIP with password out-of-band). Please redact any references that would identify other customers. We will need the vendor attestation and the date formatted in the cover note for our SOC2 auditor.

Procurement note (Nina copied): our team prefers the file delivered and a short cover e-mail stating the test scope and vendor. No DocuSign required unless there are additional fees; Nina will advise if we need an SOW.

Also, can you confirm the name of the Red Harbor tester(s) on record (company-level is fine) and whether remediation tickets existed for high/critical findings with current status? Our SOC2 binder needs the remediation status snapshot at delivery time.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Tom

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@acmehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test findings + secure transfer options

Tom / Nina —

Update and plan: we will deliver the package as an encrypted ZIP and share the password via phone to the Acme security contact. Contents we will include:
- redwood_pt_exec_summary_2026.pdf (redacted to remove third-party customer identifiers)
- redwood_pt_full_report_encrypted_2026.zip (AES-256, password protected)
- vendor_attestation_redharbor_2026.pdf (contains company name and assessment date: 2026-11-12)
- remediation_snapshot_20270411.csv (high/critical findings and current status)

Delivery timeline: package uploaded to our secure portal by EOD Apr 11, 2027. Password will be delivered by phone to the primary security contact (Tom Lewis) within 30 minutes of upload. The encrypted ZIP will be retained by Redwood for audit logs and we will include an access log excerpt in the delivery note.

Neha / Vivek, please action:
- Neha: prepare the redacted executive summary and generate remediation_snapshot_20270411.csv (confirm statuses and ticket links).
- Vivek: create the encrypted ZIP (use AES-256, filename redwood_pt_full_report_encrypted_2026.zip) and upload to the secure portal. Add an audit log export and the vendor attestation to the package.

Tom — I will send a separate short email with the portal link and then call your mobile to convey the password. If you prefer the presigned S3 option instead, reply and we can switch immediately.

Regards,
Aisha
Enterprise Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment stubs referenced: redwood_pt_exec_summary_2026.pdf (PDF, 24 pages), redwood_pt_full_report_encrypted_2026.zip (ZIP, AES-256), vendor_attestation_redharbor_2026.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
